Iris’s

Childhood

Growing up on Lake Michigan, Iris developed an early love of the outdoors. She spent many days out on the water with friends and family.

![A group of people on a boat](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

![A kid on the shoulders of an older person](data:image/png;base64,)

![Two children smiling at the camera](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Slide 3

Building on her love of adventure, Iris was also an avid traveler. She loved to visit new and exciting places and meet all kinds of people.

Over her lifetime she visited 56 countries and 6 out of 7 continents, making her the most well-traveled member of our family.

![A hand holding lights](data:image/png;base64,)

![A person looking over the train tracks at sunset](data:image/png;base64,)

![A person holding a suitcase standing in front of a car](data:image/png;base64,)

Iris’s 

Family

![Two people hugging while staring off into the distance](data:image/png;base64,)

![A group of youngsters running in a field](data:image/png;base64,)

![A family grouped around a baby](data:image/png;base64,)

Iris was born on May 6th, 1936, to her father Donald and mother Iris, her namesake. She is survived by her two younger sisters, Elizabeth and Sarah, and their children.

Slide 5

Iris met Henry in the fall of 1955 at Jasper University, where they both attended school. Henry asked Iris to marry him the following year and they were married in the spring of 1957.

The two were married for 61 years before Henry's passing. Her love for him never faded, and she kept him alive through her memories.

![Two people riding bikes together](data:image/png;base64,)

![An older couple hugging and laughing in a field](data:image/png;base64,)

Iris’s  

HOBBIES

![Two people riding bikes together](data:image/png;base64,)

![A woman posing in front of shelves](data:image/png;base64,)

![A woman working at a desk with a laptop and papers](data:image/png;base64,)

Along with traveling and adventuring outdoors, Iris loved to challenge herself. At 55 years old she taught herself how to surf, took up oil painting, and traded her car for a bicycle to ride to work every day.

Slide 7

![A person laying in the grass reading a book next to their bike](data:image/png;base64,)

![A woman running on the beach](data:image/png;base64,)

![A person sitting on a rock](data:image/png;base64,)

![A person's hands gardening](data:image/png;base64,)

Iris never took her life for granted and there is something each of us can learn from her incredible journey.

She used to say, "Life is for the living!" Which is wonderful advice from a woman who was always present in each moment.

Forever

With love

**IRIS**

**LEPEK**
